topic: The voice recording found in an abandoned asylum that answered questions
hook: A voice recording in an abandoned asylum answered questions.
script: A voice recording in an abandoned asylum answered questions. Ghost hunters at the Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Kentucky captured audio of a voice responding directly to their questions in real time. Not pre-recorded. Not explainable by echoes. The voice knew their names. Names they had never said aloud inside the building. The recording was verified by three separate audio analysts. Follow for paranormal evidence that has never been debunked.
